_comment: Editorial content for DLL. Every fact is attributable - see sourceNote. No image attached. No product list is given: the company describes an investment mandate rather than products, and inventing a product line for an investment company would be worse than none.
description: Dawood Lawrencepur Limited was formed in 2004 by the amalgamation of Lawrencepur Woolen and Textile Mills Limited, Dawood Cotton Mills Limited, Burewala Textile Mills Limited and Dilon Limited, and today describes itself as an investment management company. Its stated purpose is to generate returns by making informed investments, managing risk and diversifying its portfolio for long-term value creation, and its published subsidiaries are Reon Alpha, Mozart, Abrax and Greengo. In 2026 it absorbed Cyan Limited and DH Partners Limited under a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement, and it has since exited its shareholding in Reon Energy Limited.
headOffice: 9th Floor, Dawood Centre, M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
